about.description: sGOOGL wraps Alphabet Inc. Class A (Nasdaq: GOOGL), the voting-share class of the Google/YouTube/Waymo/DeepMind parent. Alphabet is a ~$2T market-cap mega-cap and CEO Sundar Pichai oversees Search, YouTube, Google Cloud and Gemini AI. sGOOGL is a BEP-20 issued 1:1 against GOOGL shares custodied off-chain through StableBroker (StableStock's licensed broker partner with HabitTrade). 24/7 on-chain liquidity is provided with Native. KYC is required at mint/redeem. On-chain transfers are permissionless, making sGOOGL composable with BNB Chain DeFi.
about.registryInfo: StableStock sTokens are issued under StableBroker, StableStock's licensed-broker infrastructure operated with HabitTrade.
